title: Add source-span expansion

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 source-span expansion capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse the current-head ContractRepairPacket bounded source-span and content-addressed expansion-handle authority. BoundedSourceSpan@1 carries a path, closed line interval, optional redacted excerpt, optional content ID, and deterministic span identity; the compiler applies deterministic count and byte bounds and defers over-budget material to SOURCE handles. expand_repair_handle resolves only a packet-admitted handle against an explicitly supplied content-addressed store and rejects unbound, stale-tree, stale-forest, and missing targets. No PCSM wrapper, resolver, source-map authority, mutation path, or test relaxation was created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The reusable component is current-head and its selected positive and negative source-span tests pass, but it is a generic VFS repair-packet authority. No canonical PCSM aggregate SourceLinkReceipt/source-map CID binds the exact PCSM forest's file/node/span identities, no source-map-bound PCSM request/result exists, and the component's full legacy test module has one unrelated failed formal-replanner composition test. This receipt therefore reports a bounded reusable capability, not a PCSM source-forest expansion instance or promotion.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree aggregate PCSM SourceLinkReceipt or canonical PCSM source-map CID resolves exact PCSM file/node/span identities in the named accelerator implementation/test roots. Repository/tree bindings, Git trees/blobs, file SHA-256 digests, and generic packet/span IDs are freshness or component identities, not this missing PCSM source-map contract.

selected_behavior.bounded_span: BoundedSourceSpan validates a nonempty path and a closed positive line interval, redacts its inline excerpt, limits it to 2,048 UTF-8 bytes, requires a content-ID handle for intervals exceeding 40 lines, and derives span_id from canonical identity payload fields.
selected_behavior.deterministic_compilation: The packet compiler canonicalizes request data, keeps source spans as a separately bounded budget, admits at most eight inline spans, converts over-byte excerpts and excess spans to deterministic SOURCE expansion handles, and uses canonical content identities for packet, receipt, span, and handle values.
selected_behavior.expansion_admission: expand_repair_handle accepts only a handle already admitted on the packet; it verifies matching tree and forest bindings, requires a caller-supplied content-addressed store, rejects missing content, and re-sanitizes returned data rather than returning raw forbidden private material.
selected_behavior.authority_boundary: RepairAuthority is proposal-only and forces semantic_authority, completion_authoritative, and proof_authoritative false. The generic packet authority does not establish PCSM semantic authority, a PCSM source-map, a proof, completion, M2/M3 mutation, or a whole-file/full-forest expansion.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: This versioned, CID-bound, deterministic source-span/handle service already supplies the smallest reusable Python-v1 behavior. A PCSM-specific span schema or second resolver would duplicate authority and is disallowed by this receipt-only dispatch.
